subject: E-Commerce
title: Marketplace Suspension Horror Stories
description: Learn Marketplace Suspension Horror Stories in one minute.

hook.text: Amazon suspends thousands of seller accounts monthly—sometimes for violations, sometimes by mistake.

buildup.text: A suspension freezes your inventory in Amazon's warehouse, holds your payments, and silences your listings.

discovery.text: Reinstatement requires a 'Plan of Action' letter. Some sellers hire consultants at $5,000-10,000 to write these appeals.

twist.text: Competitors weaponize the system by filing false intellectual property complaints to get rivals suspended.

climax.text: Marketplace suspensions create existential risk. A business built over years can be paused by one algorithm flag.

punchline.text: $10K for an appeal letter. One flag can freeze years of seller work.

quiz.question: How do some competitors weaponize marketplace suspension systems?
options: Filing false intellectual property complaints to get rival accounts suspended
